title: Categorical forms of the rigid direct-system representation for finite local-unit-aligned totally ordered monoids
summary: We study the functorial and categorical structure of the canonical rigid direct-system representation of finite local-unit-aligned totally ordered monoids. The local-unit map $τ$ induces a canonical $τ$-multiplication-coherent decomposition into component monoids, and the associated representation reconstructs the original ordered monoid from a finite chain-indexed rigid direct system whose proper transition maps are unit-constant.
